name: Nicholas Kluge Corrêa
bio: Nicholas Kluge Corrêa is a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Bonn (b-it and CAISA Lab) and a member of Polygl0t. They lead the Tucano series of open Portuguese language models and its GigaVerbo corpus, and co-led the follow-up Tucano 2 release. Their earlier work includes a systematic review of AI ethics.
known_for: Lead of Tucano open Portuguese LLMs
